attributes.action: Dissolve Parliament and hold a General Election If Keir Starmer Resigns
attributes.background:
The politicians work for AND represent us, the general public.

Upon Kier Starmers resignation, parliament must be dissolved and a general election held.

!! LET THE PUBLIC DECIDE!!

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign this petition:

General election now – and always call one if a PM is replaced
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/771833
